qs.q: Administration of salicylates to a child with a specific viral infection can lead to fulminant encephalitis associated with Reye's syndrome. Which virus is implicated?
qs.e: Fulminant encephalitis can occur as a rare complication of varicella and may be part of Reye's syndrome if salicylates are administered. Other herpesviruses like CMV or EBV are not classically linked to salicylate-induced Reye's syndrome.
